title: Electric Cars Just Outsold Diesel Worldwide
y_label: Global new car sales per year (millions)
source: IEA Global EV Outlook annual reports (battery-electric + plug-in hybrid car sales, 2016-2023) alongside industry estimates of global diesel passenger-car sales compiled from JATO Dynamics, ACEA and ICCT reporting on diesel's collapsing share of new-car sales (from over 50% of Europe's market in 2015 to single digits by 2023). Approximate, order-of-magnitude figures; EVs overtook diesel car sales worldwide around 2021-2022.
